components.text: The [color=green]Vaccine[color] is your cure against the [color=purple]parasite infection[color] that spreads on the Moon.
The [ref=stellaris:mobs/parasite]Lunar Parasite[ref] can attach to you and inflict the infection. To fight back, you must research a cure. [br] [br]
First, capture a sample in a [color=cyan]Pathogen Storage Cell[color] :
Then use the [ref=stellaris:machines/laboratory]Laboratory[ref] to research the pathogen and produce a Vaccine. Applying it removes the infection and protects you.
